problems: The blind guess (a human figure in a pose) does not match The Bridled Kite. The drawing reads as a kite with ribbons and tassels, not a person, so the guess fails on subject.
The sail is not drawn as a sail. 'Apex', 'right shoulder' and 'left corner' are joined as a thin skeleton of gold lines with no filled or outlined sail shape, so the sail has no visible body.

Labels collide and are clipped: 'bend in the right-hand streamer' overlaps 'far tip of the right-hand streamer', 'left corner of the sail, whe' and 'right shoulder of the sail,' are truncated, and the two tassel labels overlap each other.
The two tassel stars (77660 and 77516) sit almost on top of each other at the foot of the tail, so the left and right tassels are hard to tell apart.
The silhouette is a thin blue outline offset from the gold lines rather than a clear filled silhouette. It looks like a near-copy of the gold skeleton, which the brief rules out.
Orientation is acceptable: apex and pennant are at the top, the tail and tassels hang at the bottom, and the left ribbon extends to the left.
output.advice: Redraw. Build a filled kite silhouette with the sail as a clear shape: apex star 77257 at the top, right shoulder star 77070 on the upper right edge, and left corner star 77622 at the lower left. Hang the pennant from 77257 up to tip star 76276. Draw the left ribbon from 77622 through middle star 80179 to tip star 80883. Draw the right streamer from the tail through bend star 75761 to far tip star 74975. Place the tassels 77660 (left) and 77516 (right) at the foot of the tail, spread apart so they do not overlap. Give each label its own offset and shorter text so nothing is clipped. Make the silhouette a solid shape distinct from the gold skeleton lines.
